# Plain Titles, Sturdy Feeds

Version 1.4.1 keeps a feed working when one item has an empty link or the server answers with a page that is not a feed, shows titles without stray `&amp;`, and resolves the channel link like the entry links.

## Feeds that keep working

- **One item with an empty link no longer breaks the whole feed.** An item with `<link></link>`, `<link/>`, an empty `<atom:link>` or an enclosure without a URL made the whole feed fail: a new feed never finished setting up, and a running one stopped updating. Such an item now simply has no `link`, and the rest of the feed loads as usual. An item whose only link is its enclosure also no longer gets the audio file as its `link`; the file stays in `audio`. _[#46]_
- **A page that is not a feed counts as a failed poll.** A Cloudflare challenge, a captive portal, a maintenance page or an empty response comes back as "200 OK". Before, the integration read it as a feed without entries: the sensor dropped to 0, `entries` was emptied and the page's HTML showed up in `channel.summary`. Now such a poll fails, so the sensor keeps the last feed and sets `stale: true` until the feed is back, as for any other failed poll. A real feed without entries still shows 0. _[#46]_

## Text and links

- **Titles are plain text.** A title with both `&` and `<`, such as "Q&A: is 3 < 5?", reached cards as "Q&amp;A: is 3 < 5?", while "Q&A only" stayed as it was. `title`, `channel.title`, `author` and every other text value now come out as plain text, so cards, notifications, TTS and templates show "Q&A". `summary`, `content`, `subtitle` and `description` are still sanitised HTML, as before. _[#46]_
- **The channel link is resolved against the feed URL.** Entry links were already joined with the feed URL, the channel's were not, so a channel `<link>/</link>` stayed `/` and rss-accordion's "Visit channel" button opened your Home Assistant instead of the publisher's site. `channel.link` and `channel.links[].href` are now resolved the same way, and a link with a disallowed scheme is dropped. _[#46]_

## Requirements

Unchanged: Home Assistant 2026.9.3 or newer.

## Upgrading

Nothing to do after updating. The changes apply from the next poll. If a template or automation replaced `&amp;` in titles to work around the old behaviour, that step is no longer needed and can be removed.
